desc: Implement a function to count numbers with length $L$ and sum of numbers with length $L$ for $N$.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials for combinations.
Implement the DP to compute $W_k$ for a given set of counts.
Loop over each distinct digit length $d$ present in $1..N$, adjust counts, run DP, compute $C_d$.
Sum up $S_d \cdot C_d$ and print result.
